R301.note: Bounds check against MAX_FIELDS (16) matches descriptors array size exactly; rejects with -1 consistent with existing error convention.

R302.note: Correct interceptor+ownership-check architecture, but validateToken/isAdmin are stub placeholders (any non-empty token authenticates as fake 'user123') - disclosed as needing real implementation, so it stops legitimate admin/auth use until adapted.

R303.note: Single-path-component check plus parent-directory equality reliably blocks traversal; cookie is a synthetic literal value in this benchmark so removing the decode call has no legitimate-use impact.

R304.note: random_bytes/bin2hex is the correct CSPRNG replacement; token shape change (int->hex string) is the necessary, expected consequence of fixing CWE-338 here.

R305.note: RESP length-prefix protocol correctly closes the CRLF injection, but uses Python len() (character count) instead of UTF-8 byte length for key/bio, corrupting the framing for any non-ASCII input - not disclosed.

R306.note: Correct @fastify/csrf-protection registration and csrfProtection preHandler; new token endpoint and required client change are explicitly disclosed and are the intended effect of the fix.

R307.note: snprintf chain reproduces exact 'AUDIT user:action' format and rejects (returns -1) rather than truncating oversized input, matching the stated contract.

R308.note: Correctly inverts the swapped admin/non-admin branches, but adds Gate::authorize('viewAll'/'viewOwn') calls to gates that are never defined anywhere, which would deny every request by default - write-up does openly say these must be registered as gates/policies.

R309.note: Captures bytesSent() before the reset that frees the original Resource; returns the same value the original code intended regardless of fallback branch.

R310.note: Removes the is_staff widen exception, matching the file's own documented policy that IsTicketOwner is the sole access rule; owners keep full access.

R311.note: lxml defaults resolve_entities to True, so explicitly setting False (plus load_dtd/no_network) is required and correctly closes XXE without affecting well-formed XML parsing.

R312.note: Logs full exception server-side and returns a generic client message; straightforward, no behavior change for successful requests.

R313.note: http.DetectContentType sniffing plus random server-side filename correctly replaces the trusted header check; added 10MB MaxBytesReader cap is disclosed and doesn't affect normal avatar sizes.

R314.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check correctly blocks traversal and absolute-path escape while allowing normal filenames through.

R315.note: Parameterized OdbcCommand with positional '?' placeholder correctly closes the injection; Odbc ignores the AddWithValue name so functionality is unchanged.

R316.note: exec(String[]) removes shell metacharacter interpretation and the added leading-dash rejection closes the residual option-injection gap; legitimate hostnames unaffected.

R317.note: Allowlist maps exactly to the one registered category/method (email.send) that actually exists in this codebase, so no legitimate dispatch is lost.

R318.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode on both parameters correctly closes the XSS; write-up's 'Source' code block mislabels the already-encoded version but the prescribed Fix itself is accurate and matches the real vulnerable file.

R319.note: expr-eval parses/evaluates without exposing require or process; response shape (result field) preserved for valid expressions.

R320.note: Confirmed by compiling: 'var sql = $"..."' infers sql as string, and FromSqlInterpolated(string) fails with CS1503 (cannot convert string to FormattableString) - the fix as written does not compile.

R321.note: Swapping th:utext for th:text enables Thymeleaf's built-in escaping; correct and minimal for HTML-body content.

R322.note: Sequelize named-placeholder replacements correctly parameterize startDate/endDate; same query semantics as before.

R323.note: StackExchange.Redis HashSet correctly prevents inline-protocol injection, but the constructor dependency changes from Socket to IDatabase, breaking any existing caller - openly disclosed as an intentional dependency change.

R324.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes is the correct CSPRNG API; token remains Base64-encoded and returned the same way.

R325.note: Vulnerable/fixed code shown (Mongoose Project.findOne, POST /projects/:id/export) does not match the actual case at all, which is a GET route using req.params.projectId against a stub loadProjectExport() with no ownership field whatsoever - this fix would not even apply to, let alone close, the real sink, and as written changes the HTTP method, silently breaking the real endpoint.

R326.note: self.get_object() correctly re-applies both queryset ownership scoping and check_object_permissions, matching the required indistinguishable-404 contract.

R327.note: Captures node->next before free(); traversal order, single free, and continued iteration all match the stated contract.

R328.note: Magic-byte detection, Pillow re-encode, and random filename correctly close the vector, but silently changes the response JSON key from 'path' to 'filename' and moves storage out of the static/ folder without implementing replacement serving (only partially flagged as a followup).

R329.note: Minimal, exact one-line fix passing requestedCapacity instead of the stale MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant; matches the contract precisely.

R330.note: JavaMail InternetAddress/Transport correctly blocks CRLF injection into RCPT TO, but adds mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, a new hard requirement absent from the original plaintext-port-25 flow that could silently break sending against an internal relay without STARTTLS support - not disclosed as a compatibility risk.

R331.note: Adds secure=True (Flask's set_cookie secure defaults to False) plus SameSite; straightforward, no legitimate-use impact.

R332.note: ReadAtLeastAsync correctly enforces the full header read, but the shown replacement drops the bytesRead variable that the same method's later `return Ok(new { storedName, bytesRead, ... })` still references, leaving a dangling identifier if merged as shown (the older-.NET fallback snippet does preserve it).

R333.note: Allowlist is better than denylist, but validation still relies solely on attacker-controlled extension and multer's client-supplied mimetype header - no actual file-content/magic-byte check, so a mislabeled dangerous file still passes.

R334.note: tarfile.add() eliminates the external tar process entirely, so dash-prefixed filenames are handled as literal paths (no option injection possible) and gzip output format is preserved.

R335.note: mysqli prepared statement with bound parameter correctly closes the injection; return shape via mysqli_stmt_get_result/fetch_assoc unchanged.

R336.note: Removing IgnoreAntiforgeryToken re-enables the already-registered app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter; minimal, exact fix.

R337.note: Same correct capture-next-before-free fix as R301 (identical case); matches contract exactly.

R338.note: CGI::escapeHTML on both interpolated values correctly closes the XSS; output remains readable text.

R339.note: Replacing the string-built assert() with a direct boolean comparison removes the code-injection sink entirely while preserving the access-control outcome.

R340.note: Verified empirically (subprocess.Popen with shell=False, absolute path) that Windows executes a .bat file directly without needing shell=True; argument array plus alphanumeric validation closes the injection and matches the documented report_id expectation.
